label: 02-why-first
question: Why is the top signal ranked first? Show me the reports behind it.
answer: Product code LLZ is ranked first because it was the only flagged signal this week, with 33 reports this week showing reports suddenly increased. Report 50426770 describes "they have a case that needs to be corrected" for IntelliSpace Cardiovascular. Report 50426773 describes "unable to finalize report on Echo Module and encounter an error 500". Report 50448213 describes "an error 500 occurs for one study, preventing the doctor from processing the report".
